title: Contract Compatibility Verification
claim_boundary: Local executable compatibility evidence only; third-party plugins, hosted CI, native cross-platform behavior, signing, and public release remain outside this claim.

contract_results.result: Project format remains schema 16 and the project database remains schema 62.

plugin_results.result: Same-major plugins remain compatible when their required minor is not newer than the host; different majors remain rejected.

file_format_results.result: Legacy aliases remain readable, current format stays frozen, and future schemas fail closed.

event_results.result: Stable typed names, schema validation, identifier-only serialization, and an additive optional bridge on ProjectMutationEvent preserve legacy constructors.

fix_status.finding: 112.4 recorded WS-EVENTS v1 as documented but absent from production.
fix_status.fix: Added the typed identifier-only event contract and an optional additive field on ProjectMutationEvent.
fix_status.residual: Feature-specific emitters for link, projection, and character lifecycle events remain incremental wiring; no consumer is allowed to infer them from commandType strings.
